authorization: Jovi explicit instruction to publish the project to https://github.com/Jovifei/OpenClaw_VideoFactory.git while ignoring personal/runtime data, docs, and non-core articles.
scope: Prepare a privacy-safe first repository commit on main, then push only the reviewed non-runtime source, tests, templates, runbooks, tasks, Codex handoff, and selected redacted P0 reports.
keep: scripts, src, services, skills, schemas, templates, tests, runbook, tasks
root P0 reports and P0 change requests that pass the sensitive-name ignore rules
ignore: personal credentials and local environment files
input, jobs, media, output, state, runtime, data, external, experiments
node_modules, model caches, build output, and generated media
credential, secret, token, auth, exposure, diagnostic, or transcript reports
